resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR, firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts give 1933. The Forest Lookouts page gives 1934 for the standard L-4 house. The story reports 1933 as the date most sources give and notes the 1934 figure.
NHLR gives September 24, 2011 as its registration date. Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 2020 for the addition to the Register. The story uses the Register's own date and reports the other.

notes_for_editor: No source read supports an access level (public, restricted or otherwise), so the access key is omitted. Staffing is seasonal per firelookout.com, undated. Build year 1933 (three sources) vs 1934 (one). Register date 2011 (NHLR) vs 2020 (Idaho Fire Lookouts). Known-staff names come from one site only. Record access 'unknown' should stay unless the Boise National Forest answers. No rental found. Record fields otherwise match the sources.
